subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these exact 14 upstream GitHub Action revisions for credentialed, release, security-scanning, and agent workflows?
rationale: This is a supply-chain trust decision over third-party code executed with sensitive credentials and release privileges; the supplied diff cannot establish the repository's acceptable risk boundary.

options.title: Approve reviewed pins
options.body: Review the upstream commits and release notes for the credentialed action paths, then refresh the PR and merge only with a passing current-head CI result.

options.title: Hold selected upgrades
options.body: Keep the existing pins for actions used with app keys, releases, registries, or OpenAI credentials until their changes receive separate security review.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed pins
recommendation.body: Review the upstream commits and release notes for the credentialed action paths, then refresh the PR and merge only with a passing current-head CI result.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only evidence-backed security-routing actor in the supplied PR context; a human workflow owner should make the actual decision.
